comments.note: mcp-server/src/tools/work-package.ts CLAIMABLE_ROLES: the filter predicate `(ORCHESTRATING_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(r)` is duplicated across both spread expressions. Extracting the filtered base array to an intermediate const would reduce repetition: `const base = AGENT_ROLES.filter((r) => !(ORCHESTRATING_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(r)); export const CLAIMABLE_ROLES = [...base, ...base.map((r) => \`${r} Agent\`)];`. Non-blocking.

No blocking issues found. Code is well-structured, single-source-of-truth preserved, tests adequate, no security or performance concerns. Architecture is sound and future-proof — adding a new orchestrating role to ORCHESTRATING_ROLES automatically excludes it from CLAIMABLE_ROLES.
